Padded Armor is a Plains-tier armor. This set is the tier above Fenris Set and Wolf Armor and is replaced by Carapace Armor or Eitr-weave Set.

  • 2 Notes

  • 4 Gallery

Notes[]

  • No part of the armor protects the player from Freezing, making it unsuitable for the Mountain biome.
    • This can be remedied by swapping the Linen cape for a Lox cape or Wolf cape.

Trivia[]

  • Historically, it is yet to be confirmed whether Vikings wore padded armor. Assuming that they did, padded armor plausibly provided comfort as much as protection, more so if worn underneath mail armor (though it provided decent protection, mail armor did little to absorb or dissipate the force of a blow, resulting in bruises at best and broken bones at worst).
